title: Who you are: én, te, ő

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use *én* with *vagyok* and *te* with *vagy*. For *ő* (he or she) Hungarian says nothing at all between the pronoun and the name: *Ő Anna.* To say what you are not, put *nem* in front of the word you deny: *Nem vagyok Meg.* A yes/no question is the same sentence said with a question tune: *Te Meg vagy?*
English always needs "is", so it is tempting to say *Ő van Anna*. Don't: for he or she, with a name or a noun, there is no verb at all. *Vagyok* and *vagy* stay, because they show who is speaking.
